newsitem.title: FRANCE: S&P confirms A-1+ rating on LVMH.
newsitem.headline: S&P confirms A-1+ rating on LVMH.

text.p: Rating agency Standard & Poor's said on Friday it had confirmed the A-1+ short term rating on luxury goods firm LVMH and had removed it from credit watch.
The ratings agency placed it on credit watch on October 30, 1996 following the group's announcement of its acquisition of 58.75 percent of DFS duty free store chain.
"The confirmation reflects the improvement in the competitive position of LVMH in the luxury goods sector, despite a sharply reduced financial flexibility," it said.
